question: Do the prospectively fixed 2025 Balica-Trumpy 7/8-band centres retain enough spectral information for a shared nonnegative explicit XYZ compiler to outperform a three-band scanner on measured film spectra and a fresh natural-spectrum stress population?
claim_ceiling: ideal-centre multispectral scanner compiler development with measured Velvia 100F spectra and independent CAVE reflectance stress; not measured LED, sensor, scanner, stock, process or product calibration

research_basis.title: Multi-Spectral Scanning for Analogue Film Digitisation: Addressing LED Variability in Spectral Band Selection
research_basis.paper_reported_scope: ideal and market LED capture simulation plus one physical Fujifilm F-64D patch validation
unavailable_inputs: commercial LED spectral power distributions as numeric tables

spectral_domain.band_observation: piecewise-linear ideal delta-centre sample of spectral transmittance or reflectance
spectral_domain.target: full-grid CIE 1931 2-degree XYZ under D65, normalized to Y=1 for clear transmittance

compiler.fit_population: P6F development test sets 1-4 x slides 1-3 only
compiler.solver: independent nonnegative least squares per XYZ column followed by exact clear-response column normalization

evaluation.measured_development_status: development-only because aggregate exploratory metrics were viewed before this contract
evaluation.cave_status: fresh cross-material confirmatory stress; reflectance is not film transmittance
evaluation.cave_sampling: all audited retained scenes, fixed 16x16 per-band cell medians, relative D65 Y in [0.01,0.95]
evaluation.negative_control: reverse candidate band observations before applying the unchanged paper7 compiler

branch_rule.pass: retain the fixed paper7/paper8 ideal-band representation as an offline scanner-profile compiler candidate and next test measured LED SPDs or an independently released film MSI cube
branch_rule.fail: close this ideal-centre compiler without changing P6D-F, adding bands, retuning centres, changing splits or increasing model capacity

forbidden_claims: Velvia 100F stock response outside the manufactured target spectra
